utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m glad we’re getting the repair drive moving—let’s stick to the original plan and keep our promises to folks.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I’m with you—let’s keep it on the original plan and not overpromise. If you’ve got the key pieces, I can fill in the gaps and help carry it forward.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely—I’ll keep to the original plan and share the key pieces I have. You can help fill the gaps, and we’ll keep our word to folks.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what’s the main thing you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo — I’d like to confirm the repair list first so we don’t miss anything. Do you already have the drive details, or should I check them again?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Check them again, please. I’ll work from the latest list.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I haven’t written anything down for the repair drive yet, so I can be flexible. Tell me what’s needed, and I’ll note it carefully.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks — could you jot down that we still need a few volunteers, some packing tape, and a label maker? I might be missing a few details, but that’s the gist.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’ve noted that we still need a few volunteers, packing tape, and a label maker. If you remember anything else, tell me and I’ll add it carefully.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’d like to help with the repair drive, but I’m not sure where you want me to start. If you tell me what needs doing, I can take that on.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rey — I’d like to nail down the basics first. Could you start by helping list the main repair jobs and who’s available for each?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure — I can start a simple list of the main repair jobs and note who’s available for each. If you give me the job list or the volunteers, I’ll sort it out.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What exactly needs repairing, and when is the drive supposed to happen?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still piecing it together from what folks have said, but I think it’s mostly the porch steps and a few loose fence boards. I’m not sure on the date yet, but I can ask around and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it. Please confirm the exact repairs and a date as soon as you can—no guesswork.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I’ve been hearing a bit about the repair drive—seems like folks are pitching in fast. I don’t know all the details yet, but I’m sure it’s going to help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I’m happy to lend a hand—tools, muscle, whatever helps. Just point me at the next thing that needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s so good to hear, Gus—people are really going to appreciate that. I’ll check who needs you next and let you know as soon as I hear!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Count me in — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and get folks there fast.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect — I’ll lock in the exact location and timing so everyone arrives without a hitch.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — once you’ve got the details, I’ll blast them out neighborhood-wide and make sure folks show up ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help out with the repair drive. What needs doing first?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Sam — before we start, can you confirm the first task and share the source for what’s needed?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I think the first task is to sort the tools and supplies, based on what you just said. If you’ve got the list handy, I’ll follow that.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ll keep everyone posted and make sure the repair drive details stay clear—if anything changes, I’ll confirm it right away.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good, Rosa—just send me the gist if anything changes and I’ll keep it moving.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll send you the gist first, then the full update if anything shifts. We’ll keep it simple and make sure everyone stays aligned.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m hearing the repair drive is the plan, so let’s keep it simple and keep it moving. Tell me what needs fixing first, and I’ll repeat it to whoever needs to hear it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Start with the broken porch steps and the fence gate, then the leaking kitchen tap. That’s the order I’d stick to.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it — broken porch steps, then the fence gate, then the leaking kitchen tap. I’ll keep repeating that order so everybody stays on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh yes, the repair drive — I’m happy to help, but I’m a bit foggy on the details. What was it we were fixing again?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It was for the community hall roof, I think. I’m not certain on the rest, but that’s what I remember.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, right, the community hall roof — that sounds familiar. Let’s go with that, and I can help however I’m able.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m in for the repair drive—let’s keep it simple and make sure everyone knows where to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, that’ll help a lot—I’ve heard a few folks asking where to drop things off. I’ll spread the word and point them to the right spot.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect — I’ll make sure the drop-off spot is clear to everyone I talk to, too. Thanks for helping get it out there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely—I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure folks know where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Quinn—just let me know the time and place when you’ve got it pinned down.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You got it — I’ll pin down the time and place and send it out right away.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still figuring out the repair drive, honestly. If you’ve got the latest on it, I’m all ears.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d stick with the current plan and keep it simple: tell me what’s done, what’s left, and what day you want to finish it by.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it — the drive’s partly done, and I still need to finish the final checks and calibration. I can have it wrapped by Friday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help, but I need to keep this tight around school pickup. If the repair drive has a clear time window, I can tell you right away what I can manage.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That works, Faye — we can keep it tight. If you can give me your exact window, I’ll fit the repair drive around it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m free from 12:30 to 2:00, but I need to leave by 2:10 for pickup. If the repair drive fits that, I’m in.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I’m in for the repair drive, and I’ll help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Nice, that’s the plan then — I’m telling everyone about the repair drive and keeping it simple. Thanks for helping spread the word, Jules!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll keep it simple too and pass it along to my friends.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I can pitch in—bring me whatever needs fixing and I’ll take a look this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would be a big help, Gus. Could we make a quick list of what needs fixing and when you can swing by?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing—let’s make the list, and I can swing by this weekend once you’ve got the details together.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping the repair drive details straight—location, timing, and what needs fixing. If you want, I can help map out the next steps exactly.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be a huge help, Opal—let’s nail down the location, timing, and repair list so nobody gets mixed up. I’d like to double-check everything before I send it out to the group chat.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely—let’s pin it down cleanly. Give me the current location, the time window, and the repair list, and I’ll help make sure it’s all exact before it goes to the group chat.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What exactly do you need from me about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I need the latest confirmed list of repairs, who’s handling each one, and any dates or costs you’ve already verified.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—send me the confirmed repairs, the owner for each, and any verified dates or costs. If anything isn’t confirmed yet, say that clearly.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to take care of?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thank you, Sam. I need a quick list of the supplies we still lack, and I’ll note any commitments before we change the plan.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yep — I can jot that down quick. Just tell me what’s still missing, and I’ll keep track of any promises before we switch things up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve heard a little about the repair drive from the neighbors — what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Honestly, I’m probably behind on the latest too — I know the repair drive was getting organized, but I haven’t checked in recently. If you want, I can ask around and see what’s changed.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, thanks — I’m still piecing it together from bits and pieces.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m not signing off on the repair drive yet—I need confirmation and the source for the parts list first. Do you have that in writing?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Not in writing yet, no—I’m still waiting on that confirmation. I’ll send it over as soon as I get it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks—please do. Until then, I’m holding off.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard folks are bringing in tools and spare parts today, and a few hands are already lined up to help. Sounds like the repair drive’s got some real momentum.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, seems that way. I’d just say it’s best to keep track of what’s actually usable before anyone starts sorting.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, that’s wise. I’ll keep my ears open and pass along only what looks truly usable.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive — I’m a bit foggy on the details, but I’m happy to help out. Just tell me where we’re meeting, and I’ll go along with whatever you said last.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Meet me at the workshop by the alley at 6. I'll fill you in there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, the workshop by the alley at 6 — I’ll be there. I’m a little muddled, but I’ll follow your lead.
